detail: Two 0.1 ETH withdrawals from the Tornado Cash pool reach the operator 0x7C86…5CA0, at 07:39 and 08:53; a third follows at 08:23 on Oct 29. Two sibling wallets, 0xFD41 and 0xe4F9, are funded the same way. About 1.49 ETH in total: the operation's entire budget.
The operator deploys its first sweeper contract, 0x19be…f2bf. It has never been verified on any explorer.
Two fresh wallets controlled by the operator are delegated to the sweeper with EIP-7702 transactions, seeded with a few dollars of USDT and USDC, and swept at 14:19 and 14:24.
The production contract, 0x63e8…6fAe. Only the operator can call it. Its sweep leaves exactly 1 ETH behind, and it has an execute passthrough and a withdraw function.

A third test wallet is delegated, funded with 1.01 ETH, swept at 16:30 (0.01 ETH out, 1 ETH left) and emptied with a withdraw call at 16:47. The exact sequence used on Binance 14 three and a half hours later.
0xe4F9 sends the operator 1.082 ETH.

step: $331M of outflows on two other chains
detail: 185,017,485 XRP ($236M) leaves Binance-labeled accounts for a new XRP Ledger account at 20:05, and 965,455 SOL ($95M) moves to a new Solana address at 20:10. Whale Alert labels the senders as Binance; Binance has not said whether these were its own transfers.

One transaction from the operator to Binance 14 (0x28C6…1d60) carries 50 EIP-7702 authorizations. All 50 recover to Binance 14's own key. The one matching the wallet's live nonce, 18914809, applies; Binance 14's next transaction uses 18914810. The wallet now runs the attacker's code.

One call moves 167,464 ETH and 63 tokens to 0x5227…2f8c, later labeled Binance Hot Wallet Exploiter 2. The largest lines: 1.615B USDT, 62.6M RLUSD, 29,934 wBETH, 11,372 XAUt. Gas: 0.000414 ETH, about $0.93.
Using the execute passthrough, a call leaves Binance 14 to Hot Wallet 34 (0xEe7a…), a proxy that accepts Binance 14 as its owner. It releases 780M USDC to 0x5227.
The same route releases another 43M USDC.

Blockscout records 533 incoming token transfers to Binance 14 while it is delegated, including 205.7M USDT, 180B PEPE and 859M SHIB. Its own transactions run from nonce 18914810 to 18914903: the key holder is still transacting throughout.
3.9M USDT plus dust.
200.4M USDT, 6,591 LINK, 7,008 UNI and smaller lines.
A basket of smaller tokens, worth at least $7.5M on the ten largest lines the explorer lists, goes to a second receiver, 0xA97b….
Between 23:36 and 23:56 the operator calls sweep six more times. Nothing moves.

Binance 14 signs its own type-4 (EIP-7702) transaction pointing its delegation at the zero address, clearing the attacker's code 3 hours 49 minutes after it landed. Binance 14's own outgoing transfers between 00:47 and 01:53 fail.
First reported by @TreeNewsFeed: 'Tether freezes $971M USDT in likely Binance hack, with no update from Binance still.'
Jeremy Allaire confirms more than 800M USDC frozen at 21:18, in coordination with law enforcement (per The Block).

step: CZ: 'It does look like a hack'
detail: 'User funds are safe! It does look like a hack on Binance. Appreciate the quick freeze from Tether (~$971m) and Circle (~$823m).' The most-engaged post of the event. @binance posts three holding statements at 21:15, 21:16 and 21:24.

step: Tether raises its freeze to 1.567B USDT
detail: Paolo Ardoino: 'Tether froze more than 1.567B USDT related to a potential Binance exchange hack.'
@binance reposts its statement with one added sentence. It draws ten times the engagement of the versions without it.
Aave freezes its USDT market, blocking new borrowing against it, per @WatcherGuru.

step: Binance thanks Ripple; World Liberty freezes
detail: Yi He thanks Ripple for freezing 'approximately 200 million' (unit not stated; no freeze shows on the traced XRP account), and at 22:22 World Liberty Financial for $27M USD1 and 48M WLFI.
CZ, replying to a net-loss estimate of about $1B: 'Loss might be a bit higher than that, but will cover.'

Per CryptoTicker, some BTC, ETH and USDT withdrawals were being processed at 22:32; Binance's 22:33 notice said withdrawals would resume once the issue was resolved. Binance Alpha trading is suspended at 23:06.
Binance addresses 'differing figures circulating publicly' and puts the verified frozen total at $2.54B.
'Binance will cover all losses. As a precaution, all deposits and withdrawals are temporarily suspended.' At 00:52: 'The current verified total frozen amount is around $3 billion.'
